desc.en: The Navy's first all-metal monoplane carrier aircraft — advanced in 1937, obsolete by 1942. At Midway, 35 of 41 Devastators were shot down, but their attack drew the Japanese fighters down to sea level just before the Dauntlesses arrived.
desc.zh: 美国海军第一种全金属单翼舰载机，1937 年时先进，到 1942 年已过时。中途岛之战中 41 架“毁灭者”被击落 35 架，但它们的攻击把日军战斗机吸引到了低空，恰好为随后赶到的“无畏”打开了通道。

desc.zh: 美国海军第一种单翼俯冲轰炸机。后机身为蒙布结构，被戏称为“风向标”；陆战队的“辩护者”曾在中途岛攻击日本舰队。

desc.en: The Navy's first monoplane fighter, chosen over the original Grumman biplane design. Heavy US variants fared badly at Midway, yet lighter export Buffalos became an ace-maker in Finnish service.
desc.zh: 美国海军第一种单翼战斗机，击败了格鲁曼最初的双翼方案。加重的美军型号在中途岛表现惨淡，而较轻的出口型在芬兰却造就了大批王牌。

desc.en: Slower than the Zero but rugged and well-armed, the Wildcat held the line through 1942 using team tactics like the Thach Weave. General Motors' lightweight FM-2 kept it flying from escort carriers until VJ-Day.
desc.zh: 速度不及零战，但坚固耐用、火力强大。1942 年凭借“萨奇剪”等编队战术顶住了日军攻势。通用汽车的轻量化 FM-2 让它在护航航母上一直服役到对日战争胜利。

desc.en: Slow, stable and deadly accurate. On 4 June 1942 Dauntlesses from Enterprise and Yorktown sank Akagi, Kaga, Sōryū and Hiryū — the single most decisive day of the Pacific War. Its perforated split flaps let it dive vertically without overspeeding.
desc.zh: 速度不快，但稳定而精准。1942 年 6 月 4 日，“企业”号与“约克城”号的“无畏”击沉了赤城、加贺、苍龙、飞龙四艘航母——太平洋战争中最具决定性的一天。带孔的开裂式襟翼让它能垂直俯冲而不超速。

desc.en: The heaviest single-engine aircraft of the war when introduced, with an internal bomb bay and a powered turret. Avengers helped sink Musashi and Yamato, hunted U-boats from escort carriers, and served on as ASW and airborne-early-warning aircraft into the 1950s.
desc.zh: 问世时是二战中最重的单发飞机，拥有内置弹舱和动力炮塔。“复仇者”参与击沉了“武藏”与“大和”，在护航航母上猎杀潜艇，战后作为反潜和预警机一直服役到 1950 年代。

desc.en: The inverted gull wing let a huge propeller clear the deck on short, strong landing gear. First flown by Marines from land bases, it qualified for carriers in 1944 and stayed in production until 1953 — the longest run of any US piston fighter.
desc.zh: 倒海鸥翼让巨大的螺旋桨在短而结实的起落架上也能离开甲板。最初由陆战队在陆地基地使用，1944 年通过上舰资格，一直生产到 1953 年——美国活塞战斗机中生产时间最长的一种。

desc.en: Bigger, faster and longer-ranged than the Dauntless, but plagued by handling problems — crews called it 'the Beast'. Once matured it became the main Navy dive bomber of 1944–45 and helped sink Musashi and Yamato.
desc.zh: 比“无畏”更大、更快、航程更远，但早期操控问题不断，机组人员称它为“野兽”。成熟后成为 1944–45 年海军主力俯冲轰炸机，参与击沉了“武藏”和“大和”。

desc.en: Designed using combat lessons from Wildcat pilots, built fast and in huge numbers. Hellcats were credited with more than 5,000 aerial victories — more than any other Allied naval aircraft — including the 'Marianas Turkey Shoot'.
desc.zh: 吸取“野猫”飞行员的实战经验设计，研制迅速、产量巨大。“地狱猫”取得了 5000 余次空战胜利，居盟军舰载机之首，其中包括“马里亚纳猎火鸡”。

desc.zh: 美国海军第一种服役的双发战斗机，也是最快的活塞战斗机之一。对当时多数航母甲板来说过于庞大，主要由陆战队在岸基使用，在朝鲜执行夜间遮断任务。

desc.en: A hedge against early jets' thirst and slow throttle response: a radial in the nose for take-off and cruise, a jet in the tail for dash. On 6 November 1945 an FR-1 whose piston engine failed made the first jet-powered carrier landing.
desc.zh: 为应对早期喷气发动机油耗高、油门响应慢而设计的折中方案：机头活塞发动机负责起飞和巡航，机尾喷气发动机负责冲刺。1945 年 11 月 6 日，一架活塞发动机失效的 FR-1 完成了首次纯喷气动力航母着舰。

desc.en: Ed Heinemann's single-seat replacement for both the dive bomber and the torpedo bomber, sketched overnight in a hotel room. It carried more than a B-17's bomb load and outlived the jet age's first generation, serving into the Vietnam War.
desc.zh: 爱德华·海涅曼在旅馆里连夜画出的单座攻击机，一举取代俯冲轰炸机和鱼雷轰炸机。其载弹量超过 B-17，服役时间比第一代喷气机还长，一直参战到越南战争。

desc.zh: 第一种在美国航母上起降的纯喷气式飞机——其原型机于 1946 年 7 月从“富兰克林·D·罗斯福”号起飞。小型发动机埋在翼根内，使机体保持常规布局、便于上舰。

desc.zh: 直翼、机头进气的海军喷气机，1948 年由 VF-5A 在“拳师”号上完成首次作战中队喷气机海上部署。北美公司以同一机体改为后掠翼，诞生了 F-86“佩刀”。

desc.en: A scaled-up Phantom with far more power, capable of very high altitude. Banshees flew escort and photo-reconnaissance over Korea and became the Navy's first jet nuclear-strike and all-weather fighters.
desc.zh: 放大并大幅提升动力的“鬼怪”，具有出色的高空性能。“女妖”在朝鲜执行护航和照相侦察，后来成为海军首批具备核打击和全天候作战能力的喷气战斗机。

desc.en: Grumman's first jet and the Navy's most widely used jet of the Korean War. On 3 July 1950 a VF-51 Panther from USS Valley Forge scored the US Navy's first jet air-to-air kill. John Glenn and Ted Williams both flew it with the Marines.
desc.zh: 格鲁曼的第一种喷气机，也是朝鲜战争中海军使用最广的喷气机。1950 年 7 月 3 日，“福吉谷”号上 VF-51 中队的“黑豹”取得美国海军首个喷气机空战战果。约翰·格伦与棒球明星泰德·威廉斯都曾在陆战队驾驶它作战。

desc.zh: 沃特的第一种喷气机：海军第一种装加力燃烧室的飞机，也是最早使用“Metalite”复合蒙皮的飞机之一。动力不足、性能不及“黑豹”，从未进入作战中队。

desc.en: The Navy's first purpose-built carrier anti-submarine system, flown as hunter-killer pairs: the radar-equipped AF-2W found the submarine, the AF-2S attacked it. One of the largest single-piston-engine aircraft ever operated from a carrier.
desc.zh: 海军第一种专门设计的舰载反潜系统，以“猎-杀”双机组队：装雷达的 AF-2W 负责搜索，AF-2S 负责攻击。是航母上使用过的最大的单活塞发动机飞机之一。

note.en: XF4F-1 began as a biplane development of the F3F
note.zh: XF4F-1 最初是 F3F 的双翼发展型

note.en: Curtiss passed the 'Helldiver' name to its monoplane successor
note.zh: 寇蒂斯把“地狱俯冲者”之名传给了单翼继任者

note.en: XBT-2 redesigned by Douglas into the SBD
note.zh: XBT-2 经道格拉斯改进为 SBD

note.en: Same Douglas El Segundo team under Ed Heinemann
note.zh: 同一支由海涅曼领导的道格拉斯埃尔塞贡多团队

desc.en: US Navy patrols of the western Atlantic before Pearl Harbor; carrier air groups flew long-range patrols as the war in Europe spread.
desc.zh: 珍珠港事件前美国海军在西大西洋的巡逻行动，航母航空队承担远程巡逻任务。

desc.en: The carrier war against Japan. Aircraft carriers replaced battleships as the decisive capital ship, and carrier aircraft decided most major naval battles.
desc.zh: 对日航母战争。航空母舰取代战列舰成为决定性主力舰，舰载机决定了大多数重大海战的胜负。

desc.en: Escort carriers with Wildcats and Avengers hunted U-boats in the Atlantic, closing the mid-ocean air gap.
desc.zh: 搭载“野猫”和“复仇者”的护航航母在大西洋猎杀德国潜艇，填补了大洋中部的空中掩护空白。

desc.en: First conflict in which US Navy jets flew combat from carriers, alongside piston Corsairs and Skyraiders.
desc.zh: 美国海军喷气式飞机首次从航母上出击作战的冲突，与活塞式“海盗”“天袭者”并肩作战。

desc.en: Japanese carrier strike on the Pacific Fleet. The US carriers were at sea and survived — the core of the coming carrier war.
desc.zh: 日本航母舰队突袭太平洋舰队。美军航母当时在海上而幸免，成为此后航母战争的核心。

desc.en: Marine Wildcats of VMF-211 defended Wake for two weeks and sank the destroyer Kisaragi.
desc.zh: 陆战队 VMF-211 的“野猫”坚守威克岛两周，击沉驱逐舰“如月”号。

desc.en: First battle fought entirely by carrier aircraft; the fleets never sighted each other.
desc.zh: 历史上第一场完全由舰载机进行的海战，双方舰队从未彼此目视接触。

desc.en: SBD Dauntless dive bombers sank four Japanese fleet carriers in a single day, turning the Pacific War.
desc.zh: SBD“无畏”俯冲轰炸机一日之内击沉四艘日本舰队航母，扭转了太平洋战局。

desc.en: Six-month struggle for Henderson Field; Navy and Marine aircraft of the 'Cactus Air Force' fought from the island.
desc.zh: 围绕亨德森机场长达六个月的争夺，海军与陆战队飞机组成“仙人掌航空队”从岛上作战。

desc.en: Carrier battle near Guadalcanal; the light carrier Ryūjō was sunk and Enterprise damaged.
desc.zh: 瓜岛附近的航母战，日本轻型航母“龙骧”号被击沉，“企业”号受损。

desc.en: Costly carrier duel: USS Hornet was lost, but Japan lost many veteran aircrews it could not replace.
desc.zh: 代价高昂的航母对决：“大黄蜂”号沉没，但日本损失了大量无法补充的老练机组。

desc.en: Allied landings in North Africa supported by USS Ranger and escort carriers.
desc.zh: 盟军北非登陆，“突击者”号与护航航母提供空中支援。

desc.en: The 'Great Marianas Turkey Shoot': Hellcats destroyed most of Japan's carrier air power in two days.
desc.zh: “马里亚纳猎火鸡”：“地狱猫”在两天内摧毁了日本绝大部分舰载航空兵力。

desc.en: Largest naval battle in history. Carrier aircraft sank the super-battleship Musashi; escort-carrier Wildcats and Avengers fought off the Center Force off Samar.
desc.zh: 史上规模最大的海战。舰载机击沉超级战列舰“武藏”号；萨马岛外，护航航母的“野猫”和“复仇者”击退了中央舰队。

desc.en: Carrier aircraft provided close air support for the Marine landings.
desc.zh: 舰载机为陆战队登陆提供近距空中支援。

desc.en: Three months of kamikaze attacks; carrier fighters flew constant combat air patrols over the fleet.
desc.zh: 长达三个月的神风攻击，舰载战斗机持续在舰队上空执行战斗空中巡逻。

desc.en: Some 380 carrier aircraft sank the battleship Yamato before she could reach Okinawa.
desc.zh: 约 380 架舰载机在“大和”号抵达冲绳之前将其击沉。

desc.en: Amphibious landing behind North Korean lines, covered by Corsairs, Skyraiders and Panthers.
desc.zh: 在朝鲜军后方实施的两栖登陆，“海盗”“天袭者”与“黑豹”提供掩护。

desc.en: Carrier-based Corsairs flew close support for the 1st Marine Division in sub-zero conditions.
desc.zh: 舰载“海盗”在严寒中为陆战一师提供近距空中支援。

desc.en: Lead ship of the 24-strong Essex class, the backbone of the fast carrier task forces.
desc.zh: 共 24 艘的埃塞克斯级首舰，快速航母特混舰队的中坚。

name.zh: 美国首次喷气机航母着舰

desc.en: The McDonnell XFD-1 Phantom landed and took off from USS Franklin D. Roosevelt.
desc.zh: 麦克唐纳 XFD-1“鬼怪”在“富兰克林·D·罗斯福”号上完成起降。

desc.en: First US carrier with an armoured flight deck, built to operate the heavier post-war aircraft.
desc.zh: 美国首艘装甲飞行甲板航母，为更重的战后舰载机而设计。
